parsed.g: List all opened issues in the root/metaseq repository that don't have any labels
P_t: Navigated to the Issues list page for root/metaseq repository
Identified that there are 95 open issues total in the repository
R_t: Apply a correct 'No label' filter to show only open issues without any labels
List/read all the open issues that have no labels
parsed.e_t: The current page is the Issues list for Administrator/metaseq on GitLab. The ground-truth DOM shows the page is at URL '/root/metaseq/-/issues?sort=created_date&state=opened&first_page_size=20'. The page renders a Vue.js app via 'js-issues-list-root' data element. The sidebar shows 95 open issues. The page title is 'Issues · Administrator / metaseq · GitLab'. The main content area contains the issues list component but the actual rendered issue list content is not visible in the static DOM (it is rendered client-side). The page is currently showing the open issues tab with no active label filter applied (the URL has no label_name parameter).
C: Must filter for open issues only (state=opened)
Must filter for issues with no labels (label_name[]=No+Label or equivalent GitLab filter)
The correct GitLab syntax for filtering unlabeled issues is via the Label dropdown selecting 'No label', not via text search syntax like 'label:None' or '-label:*'

F_t.action: Typed 'label:None' into search/filter textbox [2538] at step 2
F_t.cause: The text input interpreted 'label:None' literally and applied a filter for label named 'e' (label_name[]=e per URL), producing no results. GitLab's issues list filter textbox does not accept free-text label filter syntax this way.

F_t.action: Typed '-label:*' into search/filter textbox [3328] at step 4
F_t.cause: The filter '-label:*' is not a valid GitLab issues filter syntax. The DOM at step 5 shows 'Open 0' issues and 'Sorry, your filter produced no results', confirming this syntax matched nothing. The filter token '-label:*' was stored as a literal filter string.

F_t.action: Clicked Clear button [4278] at step 5 to remove the '-label:*' filter
F_t.cause: Clicking Clear removed the active filter token but the ground-truth DOM shows the page returned to the default open issues view (URL: sort=created_date&state=opened&first_page_size=20) with no label filter applied, not a 'No label' filter. The clear action succeeded in removing the bad filter but did not apply the desired 'No label' filter.

F_t.action: Typed 'label:None' into search/filter textbox [4384] at step 6
F_t.cause: The ground-truth DOM at step 6 shows the page is at the default open issues URL with no label filter parameter, indicating the 'label:None' text input has not yet been submitted/applied. The issues list component is Vue.js rendered and the filter has not taken effect as of this DOM snapshot.

K_t: The repository root/metaseq has 95 open issues total
GitLab's correct way to filter for issues with no labels is to use the Label dropdown filter and select 'No label', which generates URL parameter 'label_name[]=No+Label'
Free-text filter syntax like 'label:None' or '-label:*' does not work correctly in GitLab's issues search textbox
The issues list is rendered client-side via Vue.js component 'js-issues-list-root'
The current page URL is /root/metaseq/-/issues?sort=created_date&state=opened&first_page_size=20 with no label filter active
One open issue visible in a prior step (#596 'Fine-tune and collect data for fine-tuning OPT models') had no labels in its Labels group, suggesting unlabeled issues do exist
